verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live, versioned production REST API platform (hmrc-probe-1), and Making Tax Digital routes quarterly updates and tax-return filing through compatible software (hmrc-docs-10, hmrc-docs-11, hmrc-supp-3), so part of the online surface is reachable programmatically. However, the documented sign-up and registration paths (MTD sign-up, VAT registration and exemptions, employer registration, Corporation Tax management) all point to online services or the business tax account rather than an API, so parity is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence that registration, sign-up and account management are available through the API, any documented UI-to-API parity statement, and readable API documentation (crawlers are blocked by robots.txt).
